# The status-check contexts the "standard" ruleset on master requires, one
# per line. This file is the in-repo mirror of that list:
# scripts/check-required-contexts.sh (run by the lint job) fails CI whenever
# this list and the PR-gating job names drift apart, in either direction.
#
# Changing a job name, adding a PR-gating job, or changing the ruleset means
# updating both sides:
#
#   gh api repos/neb-abera/aberaTech/rulesets/3113290 \
#     --jq '.rules[] | select(.type=="required_status_checks")'
#
